verdict.rationale: Databricks documents versioned REST APIs, such as Jobs v2.0 listed alongside newer versions with a recommendation to use the latest. It also publishes deprecation notices with migration guides, for example the legacy SQL API path being deprecated in favor of api/2.0/sql/queries. However, the evidence shows only individual, case-by-case deprecation notices ("support will end soon") rather than a formal, general deprecation policy with stated timelines or support windows. missing for 10: a documented platform-wide API deprecation policy with concrete sunset timelines and support guarantees, independent corroboration of how deprecations are handled in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Jobs v2.0 API — REST API reference for version 2.0 version of the Jobs REST API. Databricks recommends that you use the latest Databricks REST API for new and existing clients and scripts.
The legacy API is deprecated and support will end soon. Use this page to migrate your applications and integrations to the new API version.
The API path is now api/2.0/sql/queries, replacing the legacy path of /api/2.0/preview/sql/queries
